new_sources.summary: Hajj is a hard worship for the Moslems because it requires three abilities at the same time: physical ability, mental ability, and ﬁnancial ability. Consequently, not all people are able to perform the hajj. Furthermore, hajj is a very long process of worship and, therefore, has given birth to numerous traditions from the departure until the arrival from the holy land. In line with the phenomena of hajj, especially in the context of Gresik East Java Indonesia, this study strives to explore how the tradition of hajj is performed. By using qualitative method, this research found some important ﬁndings. First, there are various traditions conducted by people of Gresik in terms of performing haj
new_sources.title: Pilgrimage, Tradition, and Social Status: The Ritual of Hajj as an Identity for Moslems Community in Gresik
